content: This medication contains two active ingredients, netupitant and palonosetron, and is used to prevent nausea and vomiting caused by chemotherapy. Before using this product, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to netupitant, palonosetron, other anti-nausea serotonin blockers (e.g., ondansetron), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if clearly needed. It is not known whether this medication passes into breast milk, so consult your doctor before breastfeeding. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This medication may slow the removal of other drugs from your body, potentially affecting their efficacy. Similarly, other medications may affect the removal of this product from your body. Examples of interacting drugs include rifamycins (e.g., rifampin) and certain antidepressants (e.g., SSRIs like fluoxetine or SNRIs like duloxetine). The risk of serotonin syndrome, a rare but serious condition, increases if you are taking other drugs that raise serotonin levels, such as MDMA (ecstasy), St. John’s wort, or certain antidepressants. Symptoms of serotonin syndrome include agitation, hallucinations, rapid heartbeat, dizziness, and severe nausea. Inform your doctor immediately if you experience these symptoms. If someone overdoses and exhibits severe symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911) immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. If you miss a dose, consult your doctor or pharmacist promptly for a new dosing schedule. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this medication and your specific health needs.
